resources.string: Khetha ukuthi ifoni yakho ikukhumbuze nini ukukala. Lezi zikhumbuzi azishintshi ama-alamu emshinini wakho wokukala umfutho wegazi.

Yeqa lesi sikhathi uma ukulinganisa kwanoma yimuphi umsebenzisi kuqoshwe phakathi kwale nombolo yemizuzu ngaphambi kwesikhathi esihleliwe. Okuzenzakalelayo yimizuzu engu-120 (amahora angu-2). Setha u-0 ukuze uhlale ukhunjuzwa. Ukungenisa umlando omdala akubalwa njengokukala kwakamuva.
Susa lesi sikhumbuzi? Izilinganiso ezilondoloziwe zizohlala.
Faka u-0 noma inombolo ephelele yemizuzu engaphezu kuka-0.

Vumela ama-alamu nezikhumbuzi ukuze zifike ngesikhathi esiqondile. Ngaphandle kwale mvume, i-Android ingase ibambezele izikhumbuzi. Vula i-OpenPressure futhi uma uhoxisa imvume kuzilungiselelo zesistimu.
Izaziso zezikhumbuzi zivaliwe. Zivule kuzilungiselelo ze-Android ukuze uthole izikhumbuzi.
Kala umfutho wegazi lakho uma usuthola ithuba.
